study.name: H11: 384px Pro Pilot — Image Baseline
study.description:
Gemini 3.1 Pro single-pass image-track proposer (T=0.0) on the full 384px
evaluation area (611 tiles). Direct comparison with Flash image baseline
(F1=0.716 with PV). Tests whether a stronger proposer model improves
detection quality in the PV pipeline.
